defect.mechanism: Backward interval scan stopped when the immediately prior interval ended before the query point. BED interval ends are not monotonic in start order, so a short nested interval can hide an earlier long interval that still overlaps the point.
defect.screen_effect: No count difference observed on Registry-V4 PLS for this denominator; SCREEN overlap remained 178778.
defect.independent_reproduction: Correct query used sorted starts plus prefix-maximum interval ends and same-strand FANTOM filtering.

rules: SCREEN uses robust point overlap without strand filtering.
FANTOM uses robust point overlap and requires BED strand == GENCODE transcript strand.
Nested intervals cannot terminate the backward search unless the prefix maximum end is <= the query point.
regression_tests: opposite-strand FANTOM overlap does not annotate candidate
short later-starting nested interval cannot hide an earlier long overlap

interpretation: The frozen FANTOM/SCREEN preflight counts are retained as correct. The historical V1 helper is not suitable for authoritative dual-ledger materialization; only the repaired successor builder may produce the new ledger.
